business_problem: Sanofi needed to replace siloed, manual manufacturing and supply workflows with a connected, data-driven operating model that could improve medicine quality and safety, prevent supply disruptions, speed product launches, and reduce the reporting burden on technical teams.
solution_summary: Sanofi is using an in-house digital manufacturing and supply stack that combines advanced analytics, real-time tracking, generative AI, predictive drug stability modelling, and its Modulus smart-factory model. Data from manufacturing, quality control, laboratories, and supply operations is captured across digitally connected facilities and fed into analytics workflows that optimize production processes, improve supply-chain visibility, and flag potential disruptions earlier. Generative AI is used to automate report creation, including data collection and formatting for Product Quality Reports, while predictive drug stability modelling helps development teams anticipate product behavior and shorten decisions around transfer, submission, and launch. Modulus extends this architecture into AI-enabled, plug-and-play biomanufacturing sites that can flex output across multiple vaccine and biologic types. The overall system serves Manufacturing & Supply and R&D teams with automated planning, experiment design, and faster operational decisions.
